KAMES CAPITAL plc Sells 7,608 Shares of Apple (AAPL) Posted by Anthony Miller | Apr 18th, 2018 
KAMES CAPITAL plc lessened its stake in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 3.5% during the 4th quarter, according to its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 206,977 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 7,608 shares during the quarter. KAMES CAPITAL plc’s holdings in Apple were worth $35,039,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period. 
Other institutional investors and hedge funds have also modified their holdings of the company. Beach Investment Management LLC. boosted its holdings in Apple by 1,517.7% in the 2nd quarter. Beach Investment Management LLC. now owns 178,109 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $25,651,000 after buying an additional 167,099 shares during the last quarter. Crescent Grove Advisors LLC acquired a new stake in Apple in the 2nd quarter worth about $2,817,000. Wedge Capital Management L L P NC boosted its holdings in Apple by 8,719.3% in the 2nd quarter. Wedge Capital Management L L P NC now owns 384,344 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $55,353,000 after buying an additional 379,986 shares during the last quarter. First Capital Advisors Group LLC. lifted its stake in Apple by 1.6% in the 2nd quarter. First Capital Advisors Group LLC. now owns 16,639 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,396,000 after purchasing an additional 255 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Teacher Retirement System of Texas lifted its stake in Apple by 0.7% in the 2nd quarter. Teacher Retirement System of Texas now owns 3,279,408 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $472,300,000 after purchasing an additional 24,352 shares in the last quarter. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 61.35% of the company’s stock. 
NASDAQ AAPL traded down $0.40 during mid-day trading on Wednesday, reaching $177.84. 20,538,125 shares of the stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 35,979,844. Apple has a 1-year low of $140.45 and a 1-year high of $183.50. The firm has a market cap of $892,113.06, a P/E ratio of 19.31, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.33 and a beta of 1.25. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter last year, the business earned $3.36 earnings per share. Apple’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. equities analysts predict that Apple will post 11.37 EPS for the current year. 
AAPL has been the topic of a number of research reports. Nomura set a $175.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research note on Tuesday, December 19th. Instinet lowered shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating and set a $175.00 target price on the stock. in a research note on Tuesday, December 19th. BMO Capital Markets reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $199.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, December 20th. Loop Capital reaffirmed a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Friday, December 22nd. Finally, Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a research report on Tuesday, December 26th. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $203.21. 
In related news, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is accessible through the SEC website . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, April 13th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total transaction of $6,833,048.52. Following the sale, the insider now owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last 90 days, insiders have sold 125,988 shares of company stock worth $21,336,201. 0.06% of the stock is owned by company insiders.
